name: jarvis
description: Personal Jarvis assistant - HUD interface and local core

scripts.setup: python -m venv core/.venv && core\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r core/requirements.txt
scripts.web: concurrently -k -n core,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run core" "npm run ui"
scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n core,ui,app -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run core" "npm run ui" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && node desktop/launch.cjs"
